messages.author: 563435cd1cb6a261
messages.subject: websocket path
parts:
Hi,

I've upgraded to Shiny Server v0.4.0 (Node.js v0.10.18) and noticed some
changes to the way websockets work and the JS paths.

I think I've resolved the JS issues, however, now I'm seeing a request
being made to http://example.org/websocket/ . I've tried a simple proxy
pass:

RewriteRule ^/websocket/ http://localhost:8383/websocket/ [P,L]

However, the response is an HTTP 404.

What am I overlooking?

Thanks,

-Sarven
http://csarven.ca/#i

messages.subject: Re: websocket path
parts: How did you upgrade to Shiny Server v0.4.0, did you try to install straight from the GitHub repo? That isn't guaranteed to work right now--between v0.3.6 and v0.4.0 we completely changed the way installation works. When 0.4.0 (or whatever version number it ends up with) is released it will use .deb and .rpm installers rather than npm, and it will come with a new set of documentation.
